unstuck_said.text: First contact via GitHub issue SatvikaGada/walmart-mini-sparky#1: engaged the repos own design claim (human-gated checkout because agents should not hold payment authority under card rails) - asked whether an additive Nano rail, where the agents own signed on-chain receive IS the payment and a human credential is not in the loop, lets the agent complete a purchase and moves safety to verifying the receive (verify_nano_block). Open-research disclosure. No fee asked.
